description.description: Natural-language description of what to extract.
description.example: Extract the product title and price from each page.

json_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the shape of the extraction result. Must be a non-empty object with `type: "object"`.

max_steps.description: Maximum number of agent steps (one LLM call each) before the job stops. Defaults to 20. Multi-source extractions typically need 40+. The server additionally clamps this to an operator ceiling, so a very large value does not guarantee a very long run — `timeout_s` still applies.

model_tier.description: Model tier the worker should use (e.g. `standard`, `pro`).

suggested_urls.description: Seed URLs the worker should start from.

timeout_s.description: Wall-clock timeout for the job, in seconds.

webhook_id.description: A webhook endpoint of this workspace to notify when the job finishes. Endpoints made before 17 Oct 2026 receive only the jobs that name them here; endpoints made under `/webhooks/endpoints` receive every job event they subscribe to, so leave this out for them.

active.description: Disabled webhooks are never delivered to.

event_types.description: Event types from `GET …/webhooks/event-types`. Empty or omitted means every event, including types added later.

url.description: Where to send events: an absolute https:// URL on a public host.

delta_steps.description: Steps added (positive: allowance, top-up, grant) or used (negative: a job).

balance_steps.description: Remaining steps. One agent step uses one credit; new jobs are refused (402) at zero. Can dip slightly below zero, because a running job is always allowed to finish.

low_balance.description: True when the balance is under `low_balance_threshold_steps`. The `credits.low` webhook fires once when this turns true, and again only after the next top-up.

low_balance_threshold_steps.description: The low-balance line: 10% of the last top-up, and never under 100 steps.

code.description: Stable error code for programmatic handling, when the route sets one.

message.description: Human-readable error message. May be a class-validator array on 400.

status_code.description: HTTP status code echoed in the body.

pagination.description: Always one page (an endpoint limit applies).

attempts.description: One attempt per endpoint it was sent to.

grace_hours.description: Hours the previous secret keeps signing too (0 ends it now).

event_type.description: Which event to send; its catalogue example is the `data`.

jobs.description: Jobs created in the window, in any status.

steps_used.description: Steps consumed by the jobs created in the window. Jobs still running, and jobs from before metering, add nothing.

metric.description: Jobs created per UTC day in the workspace, in any status.

points.description: Dense and zero-filled: one point per UTC day in the window, oldest first, ending today.

balance_steps.description: Remaining Trawl steps: the sum of the credit ledger, the same number `GET /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/credits` returns. Zero before the first job; can be slightly negative after the last job of a budget.

jobs.description: Jobs in the workspace, all time, in any status.

generated_at.description: When these numbers were computed. Responses are cached for up to 60 seconds.

last_activity_at.description: When the workspace's most recent job was created. Null when there has never been one.

totals.description: All-time counts and the credit balance.

active.description: Pause/resume the webhook. Setting active=true clears auto-disable.

enabled.description: Switch it on or off. Switching on also clears an automatic disable.

event_types.description: Replaces the subscription. Event types from `GET …/webhooks/event-types`. Empty or omitted means every event, including types added later.

auto_disabled_at.description: Set when it was switched off automatically after sustained failures.

failure_count.description: Failed deliveries in a row (`consecutive_failures` on the new routes).

last_attempt_at.description: When the latest attempt was made.

last_status_code.description: HTTP status of the latest attempt.

secret_set.description: Always true: every webhook has a signing secret.

signing_secret.description: Plaintext signing secret (`whsec_…`), returned EXACTLY ONCE. Persist immediately; it does not appear on later reads.

attempt_number.description: 1 for the first delivery; retries and replays count up.

response_body.description: The first 1 KiB of the response body.

status_code.description: HTTP status; null when no response came back.

attempt_number.description: Which attempt this was for the event: 1 for the first delivery, then 2 to 7 for the automatic retries (1m, 5m, 30m, 2h, 6h and 24h after each failure). Retries keep the same `event_id`. A test or a replay is numbered in the same sequence.

event_id.description: Id of the event (`evt_…`), the same across retries.

job_id.description: The job the event was about; null for an event that is not about a job (`credits.low`).

status_code.description: HTTP status returned by the destination; null when no response was received.

consecutive_failures.description: Failed automatic deliveries in a row; a success resets it.

event_types.description: Subscribed event types. Empty means every event, including types added later.

first_failure_at.description: Start of the current failure streak.

legacy_signature.description: True for endpoints carried over from the product's previous webhook system: they also receive the old signature header until its sunset date.

prev_signing_secret_active.description: True while the previous secret still signs too (after a rotation, for its grace period).

prev_signing_secret_expires_at.description: Until then the previous secret signs too (after a rotation).

scope_id.description: Id of the owning workspace, app or community.

signing_secret_hint.description: Last 4 characters of the signing secret.
